description: Cumulative spend limits per project. A project absent from this file has NO budget, which means every spend request for it is denied — budget is granted explicitly, never by default. Amounts are in the stated currency; the daily period is computed in the stated IANA timezone, never the server's implicit local time.

mythos-prod.note: Zero by owner default: the orchestration project performs no paid external actions. Raising this is an owner decision recorded in Git.

budget-sandbox.note: Sandbox namespace for controlled budget proofs. No real payment method is ever attached to it; the only tools reachable under MONEY_SPEND are mock/sandbox tools.
